properties.displayName: RDP brute force: 10+ failed logons from one IP in 1h
properties.description: Detects repeated failed logons (EventID 4625) from a single source IP.
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 and IpAddress != "-" | summarize Attempts = count(), Accounts = make_set(TargetAccount, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by IpAddress | where Attempts >= 10
